game.title: Battlefield Hardline
game.blurb: Cops-and-criminals first-person shooter from Visceral Games (RAWG also lists Electronic Arts and Electronic Arts DICE), published by Electronic Arts, released 2015-03-17. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters follow the single-player episodes named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Prologue to Episode 3
chapters.summary: The Prologue, Back to School, Checking Out and Gator Bait, plus the rooftop tagging feat.

chapters.title: Episodes 4 to 6
chapters.summary: Case Closed, Gauntlet and Out of Business, plus the Gauntlet stealth, stun gun and meth lab feats.

chapters.title: Episodes 7 to 10
chapters.summary: Glass Houses, Sovereign Land, Independence Day and Legacy, with hidden rooms, the BBQ, the dirt bike jump and more. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Detective Work
chapters.summary: Case files, warrants, non-lethal takedowns, the scanner, gadgets and Expert Levels in single-player.

chapters.title: Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing every episode on Officer, Veteran and Hardline difficulty.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Heist, Blood Money, Bounty Hunter, Squad Heist and Capture the Bag, class kills, Gold Service Stars, weapons, outfits and Rank 150.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Battlefield_Hardline

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3400). Steam app 1238880 ("Battlefield™ Hardline") was used. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub): Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but not written. battlefield.fandom.com answers the API under "Battlefield Hardline" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 62 Steam achievements is hidden. The 25 multiplayer achievements (from "The Big Score" on) are all between 2.6% and 3.3%; most do not say "multiplayer", so they sit in that chapter by default. The episode names come from the achievement descriptions.
